config.scope: fixed-lambda Marcus line-shape prediction, no fit

verdict.claim_43_status: UNVERIFIED (pre-registered prediction; no observed width-vs-T or shape comparator)
verdict.note: With lambda fixed at 1.617132544 eV from the Born cavity, the classical Marcus Gaussian predicts W(0 C)=0.653822 eV, W(45 C)=0.695194 eV, ratio 1.0633, with exact symmetry (skew 0, half-width ratio 1). No observed width change or band-shape numbers exist in this repository, so this is a prediction with kill thresholds (ratio 0.05, shape 0.15, skew 0.3), never a comparison. A future comparator kills the sqrt(lambda T) scaling if |observed ratio - 1.0633| > 0.05 and kills Gaussian-only shape if |observed half-width ratio - 1| > 0.15.
